findings.what: s07's only change is '喉の筋が消える', but its light row is '喉の形（光は届かない）': the change is placed in darkness.
findings.why: A shot whose change cannot be seen has no image; 止め（喉） has no visible carrier and the 無音（喉） rests on an unseen throat.
findings.fix: Put a thin rim of the off-frame fire on the throat ('喉の縁に枠外の火の光が細く沿う') and make the change the throat's silhouette relaxing, or carry the voice-stop on the closed mouth alone.

findings.what: The flame is fixed at 'a piece of charcoal' (the ladder's smallest), but s27 has it leave palm, arm and chest and gather at the fingertips, and s28 has it trace the whole body outline ('輪郭は火だけの形').
findings.why: The image prompt would carry both SIZE (charcoal) and ACTION (traces the outline); the generator resolves the contradiction itself, so the climax's form is undecided, and the size ladder is a world law.
findings.fix: Decide one: a small flame travels the contour with the contour dissolving behind it (rewrite s27 as the light leaving palm, arm, chest one after another, the flame gathering at the fingertips), or declare the size law's final exception for s28 and record it with the exact sentence.

findings.what: Two light rules break at the end: s27–s29 put the fire at the fingertips and on the outline while the header keeps '光は下から…向きは同じ'; and after s29 the page's white is 'no added source / flat and even', yet s32–s34 are carried by cast shadows (繊維の影, 縁の影, 表紙の影).
findings.why: ep09's fold shadow is cast by the fire floating between them (ep09.md:101); after the fire is out there is no caster and no direction, so these shadows cannot be rendered under '光は魂火ひとつ' — a fresh executor would have to invent a light the law forbids.
findings.fix: State the direction for s27–s29 from the fire's actual position (or declare that the outline fire casts no body shadow), and write s32–s34 carriers as the page's own tone — the fiber as a gray line, the edge's darkening, the cover board's dark surface sliding over the edge — or declare one soft direction and name its source.

findings.what: s09's and s17's whole change is a body tremor absent from the source, left to the author ('著者の裁定を仰ぐ') with a fallback.
findings.why: Two of 36 shots have no fixed 前→後 until the author rules, and s17's 止め（体） carrier exists only if the tremor is adopted.
findings.fix: Decide here: adopt it and name where it shows and how it stops, or take the declared fallback (the fire's edge shaking) and rewrite both 前→後 so the light is the carrier.

findings.what: One strand of smoke is declared at s28, but s29's before is only '火は輪郭にある' and no shot says whether the strand persists, thins or is cut.
findings.why: The smoke is the last visible trace of him; carrying it into the white changes the page's 'nothing written', and cutting it is an undeclared cut.
findings.fix: Add one clause to s29's before ('the strand thins and is gone'), or carry it one beat into the white and state where it ends.

findings.what: The voice's stop at the blank is kept, but the source's only duration cue ('空白は、短い。息ひとつぶんの、空白だ') is dropped, and s31's sole in-frame carrier is a 24 s push on a blank page.
findings.why: The film's central silence is a length, not a fact; without it the shot's rhythm is a guess, and the longest white-page shot has the least visible motion.
findings.fix: Write the blank's length (one breath) into the 開示 row for s31, and give s31 one more in-frame carrier (the edge's scale changing, the first fiber appearing, the white's boundary moving).

findings.what: '背が正面を向く' reads either as his back turning to the camera or his body turning to face it; the camera side is not declared, and a solo face close-up is forbidden before s26.
findings.why: The shot's visible change depends on which side the camera is on, and s08 is the one organ shot where 'front' flips the film's back-and-shoulder grammar.
findings.fix: Declare the axis in s08 (e.g. the camera stays behind him, the back turns square to the frame, the face never enters) and state the axis once for s01–s08.

findings.what: 止め and 送り are applied but not defined: the head tilt (s05) and the hand opening (s01) are 止め, while the arm descent (s04) and the back turn (s08) are 送り, and magnitude does not separate them.
findings.why: A fresh executor animating '止め' may hold the organ instead of moving it, though the 前→後 of all 27 止め rows requires motion.
findings.fix: State the criterion in the motion constants (止め = camera fixed, the named carrier moves within the frame; 送り = the carrier travels from one position to another), or reclassify the rows against it.

Verified by extraction: 36 light rows for 36 shots, block sums 120/180/180/120 = 600 s, 27 止め each naming a carrier, 9 無音 each naming an object, 8 organ stops one per shot, the fire's end s26–s29 with one smoke at s28, and the page closing at s34. The shape and the routine shots hold; the failures are local but land in the set piece (charcoal-fixed flame vs fire from palm/arm/chest and outline tracing; 'from below / same direction' and cast shadows over the source-less white) and in s07's unlit throat. Clearing s07's carrier and fixing the fire's scale and the white page's carriers would move this into the mid-70s.
